options.content: **Pretax account costs, not invoice or deployment totals.** Actual and amortized are alternatives: **do not add them together**. Billing can lag; missing data is not zero. Currencies stay separate. Partial UTC days include the full reported day.

panels.title: Collection status and selected-period coverage
panels.description: The latest fully ingested snapshot from the last 14 days. Stale means the collection is over 48 hours old. A range outside collected history can be incomplete.

panels.title: Actual cost by currency
panels.description: Reported resource-attributed actual pretax cost for the selected UTC usage days.

panels.title: Amortized cost by currency
panels.description: Reported resource-attributed amortized pretax cost; do not add to actual cost.

panels.title: Daily actual cost
panels.description: Daily resource-attributed actual cost. Each currency is a separate series.

panels.title: Daily amortized cost
panels.description: Daily resource-attributed amortized cost. Each currency is a separate series.

panels.title: Cost by AI account
panels.description: Account resource IDs remain visible so accounts with identical names are distinguishable. Actual and amortized rows are alternatives, separated by currency.
